meta.name: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers
meta.description: Six incredible teens out-maneuver and defeat evil everywhere as the Mighty Morphin Power Rangers, but this time the Power Rangers may have met their match when they face off with Ivan Ooze, the most sinister monster the galaxy has ever seen.
meta.slogan: Each has a power. Each has a purpose. And together, they will face their fiercest enemy.
